title: Auditing a Page at Different Widths

blocks.content: Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen
Auditing a Page at Different Widths
Before changing anything, let's see where things actually break. You're just looking for now, not fixing.

items: 320px is the narrowest common phone width. It's a good worst case and the best stress test.
768px is a tablet in portrait. Some things will hold up here, some won't.
1024px is where your portfolio was designed. Everything should look right at this width.

blocks.content: What to look for at each width: anything spilling past the right edge, a horizontal scrollbar at the bottom, text or buttons that feel too small to read or tap.
At 320px you'll see three things break clearly. The nav overflows to the right. The hero gets crushed. The stat cards are barely readable.
Those are exactly what this course fixes.
▶️ Next, let's learn more about why widths matter.
